experiment: actor Q-maximization (-lambda*E[Qmin(s,pi(s))]) for exceeding-expert online fine-tuning
setup: v11 init, 200ep, lambda 0.3, updates-per-step 10, expert->0.3, guard, exploration 0.1
result: FAILED: validation capture peaks at 0.56 (vs v11 ~0.9), collision-free collapses to 0.4-0.7, no best_safe ever written (never met safe threshold). Training returns oscillate to negative frequently.
conclusion: Naive actor Q-maximization without conservative calibration FAILS in this scene, confirming the earlier OOD headroom probe (85.7% of 'better' neighbours are Q hallucination at action boundary |d|~1.03): the actor chases OOD-overestimated actions, breaking both capture and safety. To exceed expert one needs Cal-QL-style calibration (Q anchored & not over-optimistic OOD) BEFORE Q-maximizing, not bare -Qmin.
